svg.title: AdHoc Relay: the lines, part by part
svg.text: The lines the page of the relay copies: each part, what it is
A port given at each start, the relay at a fixed address

g.text: an answer comes: any free port

svg.text: A fixed port: the same form, with the key of the fixed port
The relay's address changes: read it where its record is kept

g.text: at S: it keeps the record
the first port of the relay: it stays

svg.text: For the relay whose address changes: where it writes it

g.text: a read key: for its lines
The client gets only an address and a port: 203.0.113.7:41000 - nothing else, nothing installed

svg.text: The keys are letters and digits; 👉 🌐 👀 ✏️ may be typed as > @ ? ! - a line goes into a message, a console, a field, as it is
